parameters: \bNow it's on a collision course\nwith our planet!
\bUpdate the course calculations\nand confirm the new trajectory!
\rAccording to the numbers,\nit should make impact…
\rSomewhere southwest of Sootopolis,\non a small island off Route 131!
\bScientist: But Professor, what should\nwe do? WHAT DO WE DO?!
\rScientist: The energy reading appears to be diffusing!
\rW-We can confirm that the meteoroid has been destroyed, sir!
\bThe meteoroid! The meteoroid--it's--!\nThank the powers above! It's--!
\bOh, who am I kidding!\nI’m so happy, I could kiss you!
\bWe did it! We actually did it!\nWahahahaha! Success is ours!
\rScientist: Professor, we're seeing the fragments of the meteoroid entering the upper atmosphere now.
\rBased on current trajectories, most fragments should splash down safely in the ocean.
\bProf. Cozmo: Hmmm… Are there any\nislands in the projected strewn field?
\rScientist: Checking… Yes, Professor.\nThe strewn field includes portions of Kanto's territory, near the Sevii Islands.
\bProf. Cozmo: The strange behavior of this meteoroid… If a sample could be retrieved…
\bProf. Cozmo: Haha… I was going to\nsuggest we could send \PN.
\bSteven: I'm as intrigued by this meteoroid as you, but any meteorites to fall aren't going anywhere.
\bScientist: Wait! Professor!\nSince the meteoroid has been destroyed, what will we do with the special rocket?
\rScientist: Do you think…\nWe could finally try to reach… There?
